styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Mountain gorges, cable cars and alpine day trips.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Bazaars, horse-meat dishes and café culture.

stays.why: Central and walkable, close to cafés, shops and the metro; easy base for first-timers.
Next to the park, Zenkov Cathedral and the Green Bazaar; quiet streets and good value.
Wide avenue with hotels, restaurants and metro stops; a short ride to the centre.
Leafy and calm, higher up toward the mountains; good for longer stays and families.

food: Try Kazakh dishes: beshbarmak (meat with flat noodles), kazy and baursak bread.
Green Bazaar: buy dried fruit, nuts and horse-meat snacks; some stalls cook to order.
Lagman and plov at cheap cafeterias are filling; expect roughly 1500–3500 KZT a plate.
Coffee culture is strong in the centre; a flat white is often 1200–2000 KZT.
Book a table for dinner on weekends; popular places fill up. Check prices on the menu first.
more_time: Add a day for Big Almaty Lake and the mountain road; go early and check road access on the day.
Swap one city day for Medeu and Shymbulak: cable car up, easy walks, cool air in summer.
History fans can add a half-day for the Central State Museum and the WWII memorial in Panfilov Park.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the centre, Panfilov Park and one mountain day; add a night if you want both the lake and Shymbulak.

month_notes: Coldest month: highs near 0°C, lows around -9°C. Pack a heavy coat and boots.
Still cold, highs near 3°C. Snow and ice on pavements; mountain roads may close.
Warming up to about 10°C, but the wettest month with around 13 rain days. Bring a rain jacket.
Mild at 17°C by day. Good for walking; evenings still cool at around 6°C.
Pleasant spring: 22°C highs, 11°C lows. Great for parks and lower mountain trails.
Warm and drier: 27°C highs, about 8 rain days. Long daylight for day trips.
Hottest month: highs near 31°C. Do mountain trips early; afternoons are hot in the city.
Hot but slightly cooler: 29°C highs. Still good for alpine escapes above the city.
Comfortable 23°C days and 12°C nights. One of the best months to visit.
Cooler autumn at 15°C. Crisp air and fewer crowds; pack a warm layer.
Cold returns: highs near 6°C, lows around -2°C. Expect grey days and some rain.
Winter: highs near 1°C, lows around -7°C. Snow possible; plan indoor sights.

climate_guide.summary: Continental climate with cold winters and warm summers. The mountains nearby make weather change fast.

items.title: Best time: May to September
items.text: Warm days from 22°C to 31°C. Ideal for mountain trips, parks and long walks.

items.title: Winter is properly cold
items.text: December to February: highs near 0°C, lows to -9°C. Bring a heavy coat, hat and boots.

items.title: Wettest in spring
items.text: March has about 13 rain days. April and May are also showery. A light rain jacket helps.

items.title: Mountains are cooler
items.text: Higher trails and the lake sit well above the city. Take a warm layer even in summer.

items.title: Big day-to-night swing
items.text: Evenings drop sharply, often 10°C or more. Carry a jacket for after sunset.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Layers, comfortable walking shoes, sunscreen and sunglasses; winter boots and gloves from November to March.

transit.best: Metro for the centre, Yandex Go for airport and mountain trips; walk the core.

modes.text: One line, open 06:00–00:00, 120 tenge per trip. Contactless cards accepted at gates.
About 170 routes plus trolleybuses. Cash fare 200 tenge; Onay card fare 120 tenge.
Yandex Go is the main app. Airport rides around 1500 tenge, but watch for fare scams.
Driving is busy and parking is hard. Only worth it for out-of-town trips.
Easy in the centre, with gentle slopes toward the mountains.
Rentable by app. Yandex Go scooters run about 50 tenge per minute.
